data: For fiscal 2024, the year ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported total net sales of about $391.0 billion ($391,035 million), up roughly 2% from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was about $93.7 billion ($93,736 million), down roughly 3% from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023. The decline mainly reflects a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission's State Aid decision involving Ireland. Total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 were about $365.0 billion ($364,980 million), compared with $352.6 billion a year earlier. These figures come from Apple's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K, and you can confirm them in the filing on the SEC's EDGAR system.
